Hey Product Hunt! 👋 We built Kasbu after seeing tools like Linktree dominate the link-in-bio space. We wanted to push it further with more flexibility, card types, and customization options. Kasbu lets you create a truly unique landing page with drag-and-drop grid layouts, multiple card types (links, images, videos, maps, QR codes, text), and full theme customization. Would love to hear your feedback! What features would you want in your link-in-bio tool?
